title: Needs of Living Things
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Needs of Living Things Worksheets (Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify the basic needs of plants and animals, including air, water, food or shelter, and describe how the places they live meet those needs (summary of the Australian Curriculum v9.0 Science content description).
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the needs of living things: air, water, food, light and shelter for plants and animals, and looking after pets. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Living things need air, water and food.
key_sub: Animals also need shelter. Plants need light and water to make their own food.
body_html:
How to think about it

All living things have needs.

  • Animals need air, water, food and shelter.
  • Plants need light, water, air and space.
  • Pets need us to give them these things.
Example

A plant is in a dark cupboard. What is missing?

plants need light

Answer: light

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants eat soil (they make food using light).
  • Forgetting that animals need air and shelter.

faq.a: Basic needs are things a living thing must have to stay alive: air, water, food and shelter for animals, and light, water and air for plants.
Plants make their own food in their leaves using sunlight, water and air.

faq.q: How can children care for living things?
faq.a: Water plants, put out fresh water for birds on hot days and give pets food, water and a clean place to sleep.
